edit.description: The gate-revert record's details digest (~:4158) uses tailBound, keeping the last 8KB. For a suite reporter the tail is the pass list and the count line; the failure block sits in the elided head. Keep the failure lines first, then fill remaining budget. tailBound's own JSDoc justifies the tail for an agent's final message (~:4945, voluntary-bail) — that reasoning is right there and wrong here, so the two sites want different helpers, not a shared one re-pointed.
Drive a gate whose details exceed MAX_PRIOR_DETAILS with the failure block at the head.

summary: The gate-revert prior-attempt digest keeps the failure block, not the trailing pass list — a retry agent reads why it was reverted

per.section: Prior-outcome feedback to the retrying tick

tests: a gate-revert record whose gate details exceed the cap retains the failing-test lines and marks the elision
acceptance: a reverted build tick's <prior-attempt> block names which tests failed, not only how many
notes: Field-traced: four records on 2026-09-06 carried a count and no name, and .flume/prior-attempts/flumeapi-paths.json opens with `[truncated 16751 chars]…` with the failure detail inside the elision — the attempt-1 retry agent diagnosed from that gap and recorded a cause that was later disproved. The per section already demands the digest carry the gate's details; keeping the wrong slice is the defect.
